# Opens

A simple example that demonstrates how a module can open some of its packages
for reflection while keeping others hidden from other modules using the Java
Module System.

---

## Prerequisites

- [Oracle Java 25](https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/downloads/#java25)

## Run the example

1. Build the application

   ```shell
   ./mvnw clean package
   ```

   (*Optional*) Verify that the JAR files was created and copied to the
   `./target/libs` directory.

   ```shell
   tree --sort=name './target/libs'
   ```

   The application JAR files

   ```

   ├── commons-logging-1.3.6.jar
   ```

3. Describe the JAR file

   Describe the `multi-release-jar-file-one-module.jar`

   ```shell
   jar --describe-module --file './target/libs/opens.jar'
   ```

   The opens named module

   ```
   demo@1.0.0 jar:file:///./target/libs/opens.jar!/module-info.class
   requires java.base mandated
   requires org.slf4j
   requires spring.boot
   requires spring.boot.autoconfigure
   requires spring.context
   qualified opens demo to spring.beans spring.context spring.core
   main-class demo.Main
   ```

4. Run the application

   ```shell
   java \
     --add-modules ALL-MODULE-PATH \
     --module-path './target/libs' \
     --module demo
   ```
